description: Backend API additions - Add analytics endpoints and fix scoping bugs in existing endpoints. This provides the data layer for the new rich dashboard, reports page, and properly scoped user management.
steps: In station/main.py, add GET /api/analytics/dashboard endpoint that returns: marks_per_day (last 14 days), per_subject_progress (marks entered vs total per subject), completion_timeline (cumulative finalized scopes over time), top_enterers (marks count per DE).
In station/main.py, add GET /api/analytics/subject-distribution endpoint that returns per-subject marks distribution (min, max, mean, median, quartiles) for each subject+paper on the station.
In station/main.py, add GET /api/analytics/attendance-rates endpoint that returns per-school attendance rate (present/total) and per-subject attendance rate.

Fix GET /api/progress endpoint: add optional query param 'user_id' (int). When provided, filter the progress data to only show schools/subjects that the given DE user is assigned to (via user_scopes table). When user_id is absent, return station-wide progress as before.

Add GET /api/admin/users/available-scopes endpoint: accepts query param 'centre_numbers' (comma-separated). Returns only the subjects that exist in the station's students table for those specific schools. This replaces the current approach of showing ALL subjects regardless of school selection.

Fix POST /api/admin/users endpoint: validate that submitted subject_codes actually exist for the given centre_numbers. If centre_numbers are provided, only allow subjects that have students registered at those schools on this station.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/analytics/dashboard returns JSON with marks_per_day, per_subject_progress, completion_timeline, top_enterers fields
GET /api/analytics/subject-distribution returns per-subject stats with min/max/mean/median
GET /api/analytics/attendance-rates returns per-school and per-subject attendance percentages
GET /api/progress?user_id=X returns progress scoped to that DE's assignments only
GET /api/admin/users/available-scopes?centre_numbers=S0104,S0105 returns subjects found at those schools
POST /api/admin/users with invalid subject_code for given schools returns 422 error
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/lazeims-station && python -m pytest tests/ -q to ensure existing tests still pass
Run: python -c "from station.main import app; print('API loaded OK')" to verify the app compiles without syntax errors
